company.company description: The Sleepy Fox Bed & Breakfast is a seven-room historic farmhouse nestled in rural Vermont. It offers a cozy, personalized lodging experience for travelers, with gourmet homemade breakfasts featuring local ingredients. The owners provide onsite hospitality, seasonal farm-to-table dinner events, and guided nature walks on surrounding trails.
